and the correction stays on offer beside the entry.

offers the deletion over a note the last answer left standing

The head of the chain answered nothing for a while, and a note keeps what it
was made with: the cards of that window stay silent until this fills them.

word. The recording is only detached: one cached file is addressed by its text,

contradiction says nothing about the learner's spelling. Reading it as a correction
